results.title: Fifteen youth startups receive GH¢210,000 in seed funding under compassion business challenge
results.content: Fifteen young entrepreneurs have been awarded a combined GH¢210,000 in seed capital under the second edition of the Compassion Business Challenge, as stakeholders push youth entrepreneurship as a practical response to Ghana’s job crunch.

results.title: NFA urges Ghana Actors Guild to resolve divisions, avoid fresh court battle
results.content: The National Film Authority (NFA) has appealed to the leadership and members of the Ghana Actors Guild (GAG) to resolve their ongoing differences through dialogue, warning that renewed tensions could plunge the association into another legal battle

results.title: Kofi Tonto says Ghana’s rent crisis has been neglected by successive governments, media
results.content: A National Communications Member of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), Kofi Tonto, says Ghana has neglected discussions on the country's rental challenges, blaming successive governments, the media, civil society and other national leadership for failing to give the issue the attention it deserves.

results.title: ‘3 Shots For Baby Jesus’ brings Accra nightlife to theatre this Christmas
results.content: Audiences at 3 Shots For Baby Jesus, the new Christmas play by Ghanaian filmmaker and playwright Joewackle J. Kusi, will spend the evening as customers of a struggling bar in Accra, ordering drinks and performing with the band while its staff try to rescue their kidnapped MC from a loan shark. results.title: Emotional outbursts will not solve student accommodation crisis – Vicky Bright
results.content: International corporate lawyer and entrepreneur Vicky Bright says emotional outbursts and public confrontations over university hostel fees will not resolve Ghana’s longstanding student accommodation crisis.

results.title: UG accommodation crisis has persisted for decades; needs practical solutions – Sulemana Braimah
results.content: The Executive Director of the Media Foundation for West Africa (MFWA), Sulemana Braimah, says Ghana has failed to adequately address the longstanding accommodation crisis facing university students, warning that continued discussions without concrete action will not resolve the problem.

results.title: UniMAC inducts Ernest Ofori Sarpong as first Chancellor, secures GH¢10m government funding
results.content: The University of Media, Arts and Communication (UniMAC) has inducted businessman Ernest Ofori Sarpong as its first Chancellor, with the government announcing GH¢10 million in seed funding to support the university’s development

results.title: GNFS firefighters avert disaster as tanker catches fire at Tamale filling station
results.content: Firefighters from the Ghana National Fire Service (GNFS) have averted a potential disaster after swiftly extinguishing a fire involving a tanker at Naagamni Filling Station at Nyohini in Tamale.

results.title: Gov’t pledges support for justice over killing of Javits Frimpong
results.content: Deputy Foreign Affairs Minister James Gyakye Quayson has assured the family of 15-year-old Ghanaian student Javits Badu Nkansah Frimpong of the government’s support in pursuing justice following his fatal shooting in the Bronx, New York.

results.title: Livestream: Newsfile examines UG hostel fees, AG’s 48-hour detention directive and presidential jet purchase
results.content: The cost of student accommodation at the University of Ghana, the enforcement of constitutional rights of arrested persons and the government's decision to acquire a US$60.68 million presidential jet will dominate discussions on this week's edition of Newsfile.

results.title: GPL: NASCO presents prizes to Hearts of Oak duo for being best player and coach for October
results.content: NASCO Electronics, through its parent company Electroland Ghana Limited, has presented prizes to Accra Hearts of Oak duo Nebojsa Kapor and Kelvin Osei Asibey after the pair were named the best coach and best player respectively for the month of October in the Ghana Premier League.

results.title: GTA 6 sales hit $3.8bn in a single day – the biggest entertainment launch in history
results.content: Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) saw record retail sales in its first full-day of release, hitting $3.8bn (£2.9bn), making it the biggest entertainment launch in history.

results.title: Massive hope for pancreatic cancer pill after trial saw tumours vanish
results.content: Experts are calling it the biggest breakthrough in pancreatic cancer treatment for decades — a daily pill that appears to shrink and possibly even eliminate tumours in some patients with one of the deadliest and hardest-to-treat cancers.

results.title: TDC Ghana Ltd wins 4 awards at 2026 Annual Internal Audit Conference
results.content: TDC Ghana Ltd has earned four prestigious awards at the 2026 Annual Internal Audit Conference, reinforcing its growing record of institutional excellence and commitment to sound corporate governance.

results.title: Students Loan Trust Fund sensitises tertiary students on available education financing opportunities
results.content: The Students Loan Trust Fund (SLTF) has affirmed its commitment to improving access to tertiary education financing as it launches an extensive student orientation and sensitisation exercise at selected tertiary institutions nationwide.

results.title: Ensign Global University celebrates its 2026 graduating class in 11th Congregation
results.content: Ensign Global University marked its 11th Congregation for the 2025/2026 academic year on November 14, graduating 65 Master of Public Health (MPH) students—comprising 32 males and 33 females.

results.title: BoG’s 300bps rate cut never happened; market rates actually increased – Gideon Boako
results.content: Tano North Member of Parliament, Dr Gideon Boako, has challenged claims that the Bank of Ghana’s reduction of the Monetary Policy Rate from 14% to 11% represents a cut in prevailing market interest rates.

results.title: Mpraeso MP calls for greater Ghanaian ownership of economy under New Economy agenda
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Mpraeso, Davis Ansah Opoku, has called for greater Ghanaian ownership of the country’s economic opportunities, insisting that the government’s New Economy agenda must prioritise indigenous businesses and entrepreneurs. results.title: GSA recovers GH¢400,000 rent arrears after High Court victory
results.content: The Ghana Shippers’ Authority (GSA) has recovered about GH¢400,000 in unpaid rent after securing a High Court ruling that upholds its authority to enforce regulations under the Ghana Shippers’ Authority Act, 2024 (Act 1122).

results.title: Food suppliers suspend planned picketing over unpaid arrears
results.content: The Controlled Food Suppliers Association has given the Ghana Commodity Exchange (GCX) and the National Food Buffer Stock Company (NAFCO) a reprieve, suspending plans to picket the two institutions over outstanding payments to its members.

results.title: Black Challenge make history with Turkey win to set up Amputee World Cup final against Morocco
results.content: Ghana’s Black Challenge have reached the final of the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup for the first time in their history after beating defending champions Turkey 4-2 on penalties in the early hours of Saturday in Mexico. results.title: Mpraeso MP challenges Big Push figures in 2027 Budget
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Mpraeso, Davis Ansah Opoku, has questioned discrepancies in the financial allocations for the government’s Big Push infrastructure programme, demanding clarity on the actual amount Parliament is being asked to approve.

results.title: Mpraeso MP jabs government over cocaine trafficking, calls for ‘Cocaine Board’
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Mpraeso, Davis Ansah Opoku, has questioned Ghana’s ability to combat cocaine trafficking, sarcastically suggesting that the government might as well establish a Ghana Cocaine Board if the movement of illicit drugs through the country’s export channels cannot be effectively controlled.

results.title: National Apprenticeship Programme: 13,309 graduate in fashion, farming and hospitality
results.content: The National Programme (NAP) has produced its first graduating class, with 13,309 young Ghanaians completing training across all 16 regions.

results.title: Give Ghana’s mines to competent Ghanaian businesses — Mpraeso MP urges gov’t
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Mpraeso, Davis Ansah Opoku, has called on the government to prioritise competent Ghanaian-owned businesses in the management and operation of the country’s mineral resources, insisting that Ghana must move beyond limited ownership stakes in its own mines.

results.title: Lands Minister hails Newmont’s two decades of transformative economic impact in Ghana
results.content: The Minister for Lands and Natural Resources, Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah, has commended mining giant Newmont for 20 years of commercial gold production in Ghana, praising the company’s contributions to national revenue, job creation, local development, and environmental restoration.

results.title: How Nkrumah secretly communicated with his cameraman Dr Chris Hesse, using a walking stick
results.content: Ghana’s first President, Dr Kwame Nkrumah, had an unusual way of directing his personal cameraman, Rev. Dr Chris Tsui Hesse, without uttering a word — a discreet signalling system involving his walking stick.

results.title: Bawumia demands protection for Ghanaian rice farmers against cheap imports
results.content: The growing pressure from imported rice on local producers requires a fundamental rethink of Ghana’s agricultural and trade policies, New Patriotic Party (NPP) flagbearer Dr Mahamudu Bawumia has said.

results.title: UNICEF pushes mother-tongue teaching to improve early learning
results.content: The United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) has called for stronger implementation of mother-tongue instruction in the early years of basic education, saying children learn more effectively when lessons are delivered in languages they understand.

results.title: Akufo-Addo left GH¢680bn debt burden for Mahama gov’t – Adongo
results.content: The Mahama administration will need to mobilise huge sums to meet debt repayment obligations over the next four years, with GH¢680 billion required for debt servicing and amortisation between 2027 and 2030, the Chairman of Parliament’s Finance Committee, Isaac Adongo, has said.
